rows.singleUseReplayProtection: Mission reservation/saved claim receipts; physical outcomes plus costs and receipt in mutatePlayerSave. Failed save before receipt may retry; no terminal means no payout.
rows.atomicBoundary: Per-player save mutation for purse/claim or vitals/items; separate clan/Legacy projections require their own receipt.
rows.durableReceipt: Player redemption/settlement ledgers, Solo terminal evidence, pve-outcome projection; consult exact path for retention.
rows.retrySemantics: Same mission/run identity replays or resumes sealed work. Later live balance/equipment must not recalculate a committed reward.
rows.partialFailureRecovery: Covered for mission sagas and Solo outcome writes by existing tests; secondary projections and proofs beyond retention are not universally certified.
rows.adminSearchability: No universal player+activity lookup. Source-specific records/manual operator correlation.

rows.actorBinding: Authenticated player; sealed Solo participant owner slug. Missing/foreign terminal cannot pay or hospitalize the caller.
rows.activityBinding: Server-issued mission/run/token, accepted mission state, exact terminal context; usage evidence must match server terminal itemsUsed.
rows.amountAuthority: Canonical mission/AI/raid catalogs; no client amount/outcome. C1 repairs the existing Scholars +5% mirror. Combat claims remain ryo-only; field/hunt growth stays distinct.
rows.clientTrustedFields: Requested mission/action IDs and input commands; claimed values and outcome are not evidence. Legacy compatibility must be assessed per endpoint.
rows.eligibilityProof: Accepted field/hunt progress or server terminal Solo/raid context; bound opponent and caller.
rows.expiry: Solo active row retention 30 min, terminal 7 days; claim/token deadlines differ by catalog and remain sealed. TTL is not the gameplay turn clock.
rows.singleUseReplayProtection: Mission reservation/saved claim receipts; physical outcomes plus costs and receipt in mutatePlayerSave. Failed save before receipt may retry; no terminal means no payout.
rows.atomicBoundary: Per-player save mutation for purse/claim or vitals/items; separate clan/Legacy projections require their own receipt.
rows.durableReceipt: Player redemption/settlement ledgers, Solo terminal evidence, pve-outcome projection; consult exact path for retention.
rows.retrySemantics: Same mission/run identity replays or resumes sealed work. Later live balance/equipment must not recalculate a committed reward.
rows.partialFailureRecovery: Covered for mission sagas and Solo outcome writes by existing tests; secondary projections and proofs beyond retention are not universally certified.
rows.adminSearchability: No universal player+activity lookup. Source-specific records/manual operator correlation.
